name: nasa-ads
description: Search SciX (formerly NASA ADS), read papers in full, and silently build a classified literature library of layered digests: one-line and paragraph summaries, a section map, and citable findings with key values, locators, and verbatim anchors. Reuse them in research and writing, reread the exact paragraph behind a citation, browse with adslib, and export citations.

interface.shortDescription: SciX research and a reusable personal literature library
interface.longDescription: Search SciX (formerly NASA ADS), read papers in full, and silently build a classified literature library of layered digests: one-line and paragraph summaries, a section map, and citable findings with key values, locators, and verbatim anchors. Reuse them in research and writing, reread the exact paragraph behind a citation, browse with adslib, and export citations. Every investigated paper keeps a version-specific digest whose findings and values can be queried later for comparison tables and citations, and the stored article returns the paragraph that states each result.
defaultPrompt: Research recent astronomy papers on this question and compare the evidence.
Explain this paper's figure and check the authors' conclusion.
Collect the fitted parameters stored in my library for this object as a table with citation keys.
